about:
EPEC Solutions, Inc. was founded in 2016 in Clayton, North Carolina, on Christian principles of prayer and servant leadership. The company began with a mission to glorify God by developing employees' skills and serving customers as good stewards, while supporting communities through service and ministry funding.

The company manufactures UL 891 low-voltage switchboards, modular switchboards (208–800 VAC, 1,200–6,000 A), and the 660–800 VAC BoS family featuring an industry-first 800 V main breaker option. Production spans four North American facilities, where they also build unit substation skids, 800 VDC switchboards for AI data centers, remote power panels, power distribution units, grounding transformers, solar recombiners, combiner boxes, and EV charging switchboards.

EPEC serves the data center, solar, battery energy storage (BESS), and EV charging industries across the United States and Canada. Customers include developers of renewable power plants, data center operators, and electrical contractors who rely on pre-fabricated, factory-tested solutions to reduce installation risk and accelerate project timelines.

Leadership emphasizes direct collaboration between engineering and project management teams to deliver tailored designs, and the company offers up to 55 percent domestic content on select switchboards to meet Buy American requirements.
